author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೈವಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯಲೆಲ್ಲೂ ಲೋಪದೋಷಗಳಿಲ್ಲ
ಗೈವ ಕರ್ಮಗಳಿಂದ ಒಳಿತು ಕೆಡಕುಗಳು
ಮೈವವಾಗುವ ಮನುಜ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಗೂಢವ ತಿಳಿಯೆ
ದೈವತ್ವದೆಡೆ ನಡೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ
(ಮೈವ : ದೇವ ಅಥವಾ ದೇವತೆ)

lines: In God's creation there is no flaw anywhere;
good and bad come from the deeds we do;
know the secret of creation, man who can become divine:
walk towards divinity, O deluded one.
en.note: The poet glosses maiva as ‘deva or devatā’, a god.
en.bhavartha: Creation itself has no defects; good and evil arise from our own actions. A human being is capable of becoming divine, so understand how the world is made and walk towards the divine.
